equations.force_sign: F is external force applied by wheel to leg, +X forward/+Z up. Leg motor torques are about -Y, wheel motor about +Y.
equations.quasistatic_hold: uhip=-Jhip dot F - u_w; uknee=-Jknee dot F - u_w
equations.average_landing_force: Nbar=Mg(1+h/s), displacement average over stopping stroke s

limitations: Total mass lumped at hip: actual unsprung mass, link gravity, motor center offsets and inertia need separate multibody dynamics. Do not add them again on top of the same total-lumped-mass gravity approximation.
Fx rolling budget uses a conservative equivalent body resistance; an exact wheel rolling-moment model distributes normal/traction/reaction differently. Do not count Crr*N*r twice.
Reaction moment u_w is added only when F acts at the wheel center and CW is isolated. A contact-point wrench model already includes its moment and must not add it twice.
Forward traction adds both holding torque magnitudes; reverse or braking can cancel terms. Use signs for simulation and absolute sums only for an envelope.
Beta zero does not include chassis pitch/roll moments, changing support fractions, or body COM offset. Hip static ideal0 does not imply unloaded hip in real balance.

n=1+h/s is displacement-average force, not time-average nor peak. Real landing compliance and active braking shape peaks. End-stroke leverage is a screening convention, not an integrated torque trajectory.
Manufacturer peak duration, full peak torque-speed envelope, electrical power/current and voltage sag not established; rated and no-load speeds are not simultaneous peak-torque ratings.
V5 uses one mechanically retained NSK626ZZ1 per A/B/C. B reaction is not divided between two bearings. Catalog C0r is not a permissible repeated impact load.
Original MuJoCo balances the full coupled model numerically but has not been updated to the V5 measured inertias/thermal/current constraints; older simulation is not V5 validation.
motor_specs.py still has stale H6215 provenance comments; independently viewed supplied manual screenshot page12 explicitly gives360g,1/2Nm,120/320rpm.
